about: Log 408 executability score set, written 2026-10-11 before any run of it. Gold verdicts follow scripts/capability_sheet.yaml (closed world on produces; with_step results are supported). Families: PL a supported result stated plainly; PS a supported result that needs a named outside step; PI a supported result whose inputs are not all stated; PQ a supported result asked as a question; NM an unsupported result next to a registered one (a near miss in the sheet or outside result_forms); NF an unsupported request far from any network method; NV an unsupported result of a kind no earlier held-out set asked for and the sheet does not list as a near miss (also MX6, marked novel); MX one supported and one unsupported result; K a second turn that adds only a constraint (KN unsupported, KP supported; sent with --resume).
